description: This Ruby source file defines classes and functions for generating HTML documentation from XML files related to the lighttpd2 project. It includes classes for handling documentation structure, parsing XML, and rendering HTML pages, as well as a script to process XML files and produce documentation output.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Base class for generating HTML documentation from XML data, providing methods for rendering, navigation, and HTML formatting.

classes.name: GenericModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Represents documentation for a generic module, capable of parsing XML and generating HTML content.

classes.name: ModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Handles documentation for standard modules, extending GenericModuleDocumentation with specific parsing for actions, setups, options, and sections.

classes.name: AngelModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Handles documentation for angel modules, extending GenericModuleDocumentation with specific parsing for items, sections, and modules.

classes.name: ChapterDocumentation
classes.description: Represents documentation for chapters, parsing chapter-specific XML structure.

classes.name: ModuleIndex
classes.description: Generates an index page listing modules and related entities.

classes.name: IndexPage
classes.description: Creates an index page linking to other documentation pages.

classes.name: AllPage
classes.description: Creates a single HTML page combining multiple documentation pages.

methods.name: loadXML
methods.description: Loads an XML file and returns the corresponding documentation object based on root node.
